text:
sara (procurement): FYI AWB 8888-2024 is splitting at customs. Partial release (30 units) landed, remainder ~58 delayed by HS review. Forwarder suggests FRA reroute to avoid 48h hold. Need quick call: accept partial + air-topup or pay expedite.

alpha-logistics (broker): Confirmed. HS dispute between 8471.80 and 8542.31. Options: 1) accept partial, wait 3-4 days for rest; 2) FRA reroute, expedite fee +$395 and clears same day; 3) air-topup 10 units to hit staging target (expensive). Also found 2 soft-DOA units on manifest. We can upload return labels to RMA. Portal: https://al-logistics.example/awb/8888

leo (fleet): Staging threshold = 40. Partial 30 means miss pool. Air-topup cost ~ $1,200. Reroute seems cheaper given lost capacity estimate ~ $2,800 if we miss.

mina (ops): Depot rule: DOA without pre-created RMA + PDF labels => quarantine whole AWB. @rma-bot please open provisional RMA and list required docs.

rma-bot: provisional RMA #RMA-43150 created. Depot requires: serial manifest attached (CSV or inline), PDF return labels (4x6) attached to RMA, photos for DOA units, signed vendor credit/claim terms for DOA within 7 days. Missing PDF => depot_quarantine = true.

ash (finance): Quick calc: reroute fee 395 (waivable if we accept vendor uplift of +4 units next wave), estimated extra duty $860, DOA handling $140/unit. Vendor credit option $220/unit for soft-fails. If vendor credits both soft-fails net delta ~395+860+280-440=1,095 (if we don't get waiver). Waiting cost ~2,800. Recommend push for waiver + reroute.

sara (procurement): @alpha-logistics can you confirm in writing you will waive $395 if Redwood signs a one-time SOW for +4 uplift next wave and provide the +4 serials by EOD? Also upload PDF labels to RMA-43150 now so depot isn't blocked.

alpha-logistics (broker): We can waive the $395 reroute fee conditional on signed SOW for +4 uplift. We'll upload uplift_serials_plus4.csv and return_labels_RMA-43150.pdf to the RMA ticket now and send amendment for signature. Sending updates to portal and RMA. :white_check_mark:

mina (ops): Manifest snippet for depot (vendor please reconcile full list):

```
AWB: 8888-2024
partial (30 units):
- A800-UX-001234
- A800-UX-001235  (soft-fail)
- H200-QW-009988
... (total 30)
```

Reminder: depot auto-quarantine policy triggers if labels not attached before arrival_time. rma-bot will mark quarantine flag.

rma-bot: reminder: attach PDFs to RMA-43150. If not attached before arrival_time, set depot_quarantine=true. RMA status = pending_documents.

sara (procurement): Thanks. I'll watch for the amendment and countersign if legal ok. Proceed with FRA reroute once SOW countersigned and labels live.

alpha-logistics (broker): Uploaded: return_labels_RMA-43150.pdf and uplift_serials_plus4.csv. Amendment sent to procurement/legal. We'll coordinate invoices for duty. Thanks. :thumbsup:
